title: My Stepson Stole My $130K Orchard. So I Let Him Press Apples In 'Juiced The Truth' Overalls.
description: After my stepson forged a dissolution to sell the orchard I built with my widow's inheritance, a sealed barrel held the only proof I needed to cancel the $900K deal. Now he works for me in custom overalls, and his fraud case number is on every bottle. #RevengeStory #CiderOrchard #JuicedTheTruth
thumb_text: NOW HE PRESSES APPLES IN JUICED THE TRUTH OVERALLS
pinned_comment: If your stepson stole your $130K inheritance and left you a $7,000 crate of thanks, would you have made him press apples in overalls that confess the truth? Share how you'd handle it in the comments.

thumb_lines.text: I TRUSTED HIM WITH MY $130K WIDOW'S INHERITANCE
